name: Kitanakagusuku (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Kitanakagusuku village emblem in white: a ring crossed by a stylised character of angular strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Kitanakagusuku, a village in Okinawa Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 20 May 1980.

features.role: Kitanakagusuku village emblem — a ring crossed by a stylised character of angular strokes
